Tramadol may produce fewer typical opioid adverse effects such as respiratory depression and constipation. In addition to hypotension, hypertension has occasion- ally occurred. Effects on the CNS. The UK CSM1 commented in February 1995 that since June 1994 they had received reports of 15 pa- tients who had experienced confusion and/or hallucinations while taking tramadol. The majority of the reactions developed 1 to 7 days after starting treatment and in most patients resolved rapidly on withdrawal.
